body.name: regularClass
body.type: A compact set of multinomial laws
body.def: \(\mathcal K(\varepsilon_{\rm reg},\gamma_{\rm reg},\sigma^2_{\rm reg})\) is any nonempty compact class of \(T\)-compatible laws with \(\rho\in[\bar\rho,1-\bar\rho]\), arm cells at least \(\varepsilon_{\rm reg}\), a unique active affine face at each endpoint separated from every other face by at least \(\gamma_{\rm reg}\), and both active-face variances at least \(\sigma^2_{\rm reg}\).
